body: Have you been able to reproduce this issue or do you need more info?
Just want to know if you have acknowledged this issue or if I should add more info? It's been two weeks.

Hi,
I agree completely and that's why I wanted your opinion before I just added the workaround.

Yes I have tried the workaround (it's included in my first post) and for me it's working really well. I don't get the MediaCodecVideoRenderer exception that you say, though I have only tested it in an emulator.

Not sure what info you want from me. I don't have a reasonable explanation, that's why I ask you. The workaround works, but I don't want to use it if the media is bad and I don't have enough knowledge to determine if it's bad or not.

I haven't had time to do more research on this. I did some digging around and it would seem that dvbsnoop never reads the invalid program info length, which suggests there's something wrong with the exoplayer parsing code. Which provides evidence against adding the program info length workaround to exoplayer. I think the next step is to define this is whether this is bad media or a bug in the exoplayer parsing code. But I haven't had the time to do the research yet. Any input is welcome.

Yes, looks good to me. 

Are you ok with me introducing an equivalent change internally or would you prefer sending a pull request?
You can go ahead and change it, most important is that it's getting fixed.
